Container.Name: ComicTagger
Container.Overview:
ComicTagger is a multi-platform app for writing metadata to digital comics (CBZ/CBR/CB7), with Comic Vine lookup, batch auto-tagging and file renaming. This container runs the ComicTagger desktop GUI and serves it to your browser (noVNC), so you can tag your library directly on the server. The CLI is also available via "docker exec ComicTagger comictagger ...".
Note: CBR files are read-only (writing RAR needs the proprietary rar tool). Use "Export to Zip" in ComicTagger to convert them to CBZ.

Config.Name: VNC Port
Config.Description: Optional: port for connecting with a regular VNC client. Leave blank to not expose it.

Config.Name: Comics
Config.Description: Your comic library. ComicTagger writes tags into these files, so it needs read/write access.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: ComicTagger settings, Comic Vine API key, cache and logs.

Config.Name: PUID (USER_ID)
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as. 99 = nobody on Unraid.

Config.Name: PGID (GROUP_ID)
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as. 100 = users on Unraid.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Permission mask for new files. 0000 matches Unraid's default share permissions.

Config.Name: Keep app running
Config.Description: 1 = automatically restart ComicTagger if it is closed or crashes.

Config.Name: Dark mode (web UI)
Config.Description: 1 = dark theme for the web page around the app.

Config.Name: ComicTagger extra args
Config.Description: Optional extra command-line flags passed to the ComicTagger GUI.

Config.Name: Secure connection (HTTPS)
Config.Description: 1 = serve the web UI over HTTPS (self-signed cert). Required for web login.

Config.Name: Web login
Config.Description: 1 = require a username/password for the web UI. Needs Secure connection = 1.
